title: Deer reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#C8843C"/>
  <!-- Deer chest lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="13" ry="13" fill="#E0A85C"/>
  
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="40" y="42" width="20" height="18" rx="8" fill="#C8843C"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#C8843C"/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="24" rx="6" ry="9" transform="rotate(-25 33 24)" fill="#C8843C"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="24" rx="3.5" ry="6" transform="rotate(-25 33 24)" fill="#F0C080"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="24" rx="6" ry="9" transform="rotate(25 67 24)" fill="#C8843C"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="24" rx="3.5" ry="6" transform="rotate(25 67 24)" fill="#F0C080"/>
  
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M40 26 Q35 14 28 8" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M35 16 Q30 12 24 13" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 26 Q65 14 72 8" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M65 16 Q70 12 76 13" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="39" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#F0C080"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <circle cx="43.8" cy="33.2" r="0.8" fill="#FFE8B0"/>
  <circle cx="57.8" cy="33.2" r="0.8" fill="#FFE8B0"/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#5A3010"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M46 44 Q50 47 54 44" stroke="#5A3010" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Book -->
  <path d="M30 60 L50 65 L70 60 L70 78 L50 83 L30 78 Z" fill="#2255CC"/>
  <path d="M30 60 L50 65 L50 83 L30 78 Z" fill="#1A44AA"/>
  <path d="M50 65 L70 60 L70 78 L50 83 Z" fill="#2A66DD"/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <path d="M32 62 L50 66 L50 80 L32 76 Z" fill="#FFF4D6"/>
  <path d="M50 66 L68 62 L68 76 L50 80 Z" fill="#FFEEC0"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="35" y1="66" x2="48" y2="69" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="69" x2="48" y2="72" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="72" x2="48" y2="75" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="69" x2="65" y2="66" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="72" x2="65" y2="69" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="75" x2="65" y2="72" stroke="#D4C4A0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="72" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="72" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="80" width="7" height="12" rx="3" fill="#C8843C"/>
  <rect x="57" y="80" width="7" height="12" rx="3" fill="#C8843C"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <ellipse cx="39.5" cy="92" rx="4.5" ry="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="60.5" cy="92" rx="4.5" ry="3" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="66" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#E0A85C"/>
  
  <!-- Spots on back -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="62" r="1.8" fill="#E8C890"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="67" r="1.5" fill="#E8C890"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#E8C890"/>
</svg>
